# Brand assets

Official assets downloaded 2026-10-03, preserved without modifications.

- `line.png`: LINE Brand icon PNG, https://www.line.me/en/logo — https://www.line.me/static/logo/top/LINE_Brand_icon.zip . LINE/LY Corporation retains rights. Displayed at 44px with surrounding spacing; no recoloring, rotation or effects.
- `telegram.svg`: Logo.svg from the official Telegram logo pack linked at https://telegram.org/tour/screenshots . Telegram retains its brand rights. Used to identify the integration, not to imply affiliation.
